# sentry_team (Data Source)

Looks up a team by slug or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_team" "backend" {
  slug = "backend"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Team ID. Set this or `slug`.
- `slug` (String) Team slug. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the team.
